feats.title: Bloodthirsty Visage
feats.description: You gain a feat bonus equal to your Charisma to damage rolls with barbarian fear powers.

feats.title: Charging Rampage
feats.description: When you score a critical hit with a barbarian attack power while you are raging, you can charge as a free action, instead of making a melee basic attack as a result of Rampage.

feats.title: Double Lunge
feats.description: When you use whirling lunge, you deal extra damage to the target equal to your Strength.

feats.title: Echoing Roar
feats.description: Whenever you use your second wind, you also regain the use of roar of triumph.

feats.title: Explosive Rage Strike
feats.description: When you use rage strike, you can reduce the damage it deals by 2[W]. If you do so, the power becomes a close burst 1 that targets each enemy that you can see in the burst.

feats.title: Rageblood Recovery
feats.description: When you hit with the charge attack granted by swift charge while you are raging, you can spend a healing surge as a free action.

feats.title: Reckless Rage
feats.description: When you attack an enemy with a rage power, you can take a –2 penalty to the attack roll against that enemy to deal 1[W] extra damage to it.

feats.title: Thaneborn Advance
feats.description: When you use your roar of triumph power while you are raging, you can shift a number of squares equal to your Charisma and use your new position as the origin square of the burst.

feats.title: Thirsty Blade
feats.description: When you reduce an enemy to 0 hit points with a charge attack using an axe or a heavy blade, each enemy adjacent to you at the end of the charge takes damage equal to your Strength.

feats.title: Thunderous Cry
feats.description: When you use war cry, the targets grant combat advantage to you until the end of your next turn.

feats.title: Violent Reminder
feats.description: When you reduce an enemy to 0 hit points, you gain a +5 bonus to the next damage roll you make before the end of your next turn.

feats.title: Withering Roar
feats.description: When you use Roar of Triumph, you can replace its penalty to all defenses for each target with that target granting combat advantage until the end of your next turn. The power's penalty to damage rolls still applies.
